title: SF713 (2025-2026 Regular): Permitted and trained school staff carrying of firearms authorization

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2025-01-24; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2025/0/SF/713/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced text, 2025-01-24. Strikes only the word 'or' and a period in subd. 1d(f) while adding clause (10). Paragraph (g) of 609.66 subd. 1d may be existing law.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 299C.26): The training program must admit only school and postsecondary institution teachers and employees who have completed training for a permit to carry under section 624.714 within one year of the date of attending the training under this section or have a permit to carry under section 624.714.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1d): (10) teachers and employees of public elementary, middle, and secondary schools; charter schools under chapter 124E; and postsecondary institutions under chapter 136F or 137 who have a school permit to carry under section 624.714, subdivision 8b.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1d): (g) Notwithstanding section 471.634, a school district or other entity composed exclusively of school districts may not regulate firearms, ammunition, or their respective components, when possessed or carried by nonstudents or nonemployees, in a manner that is inconsistent with this subdivision.
Section 3 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 8b): (a) A teacher or other employee of a public elementary, middle, or secondary school; charter school under chapter 124E; or postsecondary institution under chapter 136F or 137 may apply to the sheriff of the county where the teacher or employee resides for a school permit to carry.
Section 3 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 8b): (h) A school permit to carry issued under this subdivision expires one year after the date of issue.
Section 4 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 18): (d) This subdivision does not apply to teachers and employees authorized to carry firearms under section 609.66, subdivision 1d, paragraph (f).
